Dear {vendor} team,

Thank you for your notice that the {plan} plan under {agreement} will change from {old_price} to {new_price}, effective {effective_date}. The increase is {increase_pct}, or {monthly_increase} per month, which adds {annual_impact} over a year.

We would like to keep the current price of {old_price} for our {plan} plan. Before the new price takes effect, we would welcome a discussion of options that could work for both of us, such as a longer term commitment, a different plan level, or a phased adjustment. Please let us know by {deadline} what options are available.

We look forward to your reply.

Best regards,
{sender}
